title: sidebar HUD arcade readability polish
problem_statement: The right sidebar reads like a compact debug table and needs to become a legible arcade cabinet HUD without changing gameplay.
game_flow_context: UI/HUD only: current level, opinion score, wave progress, Pi-chan boost, Speed Dot/Bolt state, onion pressure.
validated_decisions: HUD values must be backed by real runtime state.
Gameplay, spawn, gates, collision, Speed Dot mechanics, controls and level progression are frozen.
Impact guard skipped by task-orchestrator because this is a constrained UI-only task with explicit acceptance criteria.
draft_assumptions_in_play: A small read-only Speed Dot status accessor in LevelManager is in scope.
Existing getWaveProgress fields are the source of truth for wave HUD data.
Pi-chan status should use player boost ratio because no HP value exists.
current_direction: Color semantics: yellow score/Pi-chan, cyan Bolt/progress, red onion pressure, black/metal panels.
explicit_non_goals: No gates, collision, controls or level progression changes.
backward_compatibility_concerns: Existing DOM ids used by main.js must remain wired or be updated consistently.
Mobile compact HUD layout must remain readable.
required_validations: local static game launch if possible
manual HUD checklist from thread summary
PHPMD not applicable unless PHP/config is present
human_test_checklist: boost status visible while Pi-chan is boosted
solution_applied: Reworked the right sidebar HUD into an arcade cabinet-style panel.
Added large LV and zero-padded OPINION display.
Added NEXT WAVE cleared/total text with real segmented progress.
Added PI-CHAN boost status from player boost ratio.
Added BOLT status from read-only Speed Dot state.
Added ONION PRESSURE active/left/queue values from wave progress.
decision_log_summary: Created direct APPROVED_FOR_BUILD thread for a small UI-only HUD patch.
Build completed and routed to maintainability review.
Review verdict APPROVE_WITH_NOTES; task closed DONE.
